'''Nuun Pargen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Crescent (freighter)|''Crescent'']].

==Biography==
Nuun took off [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] aboard the ''Crescent'' in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. While he was trying to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was attacked and damaged by [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], Nuun managed to make an emergency landing outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]], but his daughter, [[Inea Pargen|Inea]], was wounded during the attack.
